notes.title: Moncage serves new looks!
notes.content:
Before we get started, let’s address the elephants in the room:

1. Moncage is set to release by the end of this year; official launch date will be announced soon.
2. Moncage will be available to purchase on Steam, App Store, Google Play and TapTap.

Now, the fun stuff:

Upon completion of content development, we immediately launched into post-production and have already made quite some progress, particularly in visual optimization. 

As you can see in the comparison below, we’ve made significant upgrades since the demo build with added focus blur, new text glow, and enhanced volumetric lighting, etc., all for a more immersive gameplay experience. 

↓ Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/31396dfa2a632ab28cc5e20746cfff384ecb4dc0.png

↓After
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/debafcdd55196115a926ed2874d2936ac902d278.png

————————

In addition to the lighting changes from external sources, we went over each and every scene from within the cube and made visual adjustments to the environments, exposure, and color saturation, etc. In the example below, the skies and overall settings have been modified in accordance with the particular scene.

↓ Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/c00873f5c2cb5fb7c05b3cec6c58ae38ef71999d.jpg

↓After
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/dc00b8a758016a3f5b644d2232b87f16f9b4f8b7.jpg

————————

For indoor scenes, we focused on adding visual elements such as windows, picture frames, and stickers for them to look even more elaborate and reflect the overarching storyline. 

↓ Before
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/d257ca83c8f9b7e481295c735d669138aaa8278d.jpg

↓After
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/0191c8e8df6586e902d58032fdb7d46af8efa113.jpg

————————

This visual optimization has been an ongoing process and we are currently working to enhance the lighting effects even more - can you spot the difference(s) in the latest screenshot below? 

↓ Now
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/de83e4515d43c0c9379c559bac1b8c9885bfb285.jpg

We really couldn’t be more grateful for your patience! We promise that the wait is going to be worth it and that Moncage, at official launch, will be presented to you in its absolute best form~ 

To stay updated on Moncage, be sure follow us on Twitter @XD_EN_Official and join us on Discord: https://discord.gg/y2HWuvJj

notes.title: Moncage 101: Introduction to the Hint Systems
notes.content:
In puzzle games, the act of putting seemingly disconnected pieces together to solve a particularly complex puzzle might be one of the most satisfying experiences there is; however, getting stuck on one maybe, well, the complete opposite of that, if not worse. 

If you, like us, have no resistance to a good puzzle game and also appreciate the occasional guidance to avoid getting stuck, then we have just the game for you. In Moncage, there are a multitude of thoughtful hints that the player can choose to activate for almost every situation. Regardless of your proficiency with puzzle-solving, this is a game that you won’t want to miss.

————————

Basic function: Focus

There are two modes in which a player can activate Focus - Classic Mode and Challenge Mode.

In Classic Mode, activating Focus will reveal the key item that solves the next puzzle. This is recommended for most players.

In Challenge Mode, Focus will reveal all relevant puzzle pieces in the current scene. This is recommended for players who prefer a more challenging experience. 

As one of the basic functions in Moncage, Focus has been designed to help players effectively pinpoint their next move. At any point of the game, players can switch between Classic Mode and Challenge Mode as they see fit. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/27c9e0b35f3a8b9b627148ade619ea1defdd07c1.png
↑ Normal (without Focus)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/b3d0a0b3e7c76c67b271fc9e5947bca1ef879393.png
↑ Focus activated in Classic Mode can help players concentrate on the next puzzle

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/d9fc9a87b2aa6449535af6c448eeebab3dfe5287.png
↑ Focus activated Challenge Mode is recommended for patient players who prefer to figure out the puzzles on their own

————————

Hint system: hint text

In addition to Focus, there are hint texts.

Identifying a puzzle is only, well, the first piece of the puzzle; identifying that ultimate solution is the game changer. When the player is stuck on a particular puzzle for over a certain period of time, a question mark will pop up in the upper right corner - click on it to reveal the hint text. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/0ddaaacb0c523e2ad04048542bc99668737ade12.gif

Each puzzle in the game is equipped with 1 to 3 pieces of hint text. These hints are not meant to be straightforward spoilers, but to nudge you in the right direction and help narrow down on the possible solutions.

————————

Hint system: video walkthroughs

Even with the subtle hint text, it’s entirely possible that a player may still be struggling with the puzzles. This is where the video walkthroughs come in.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/13e6b223ca3f8026b4c8e36c4677fbbad684833b.gif

Although we want our players to thoroughly explore everything in game and find the solutions themselves, we understand that they may occasionally get stuck. So we implemented an ultimate safety plan - video walkthroughs. 

Once the player exhausts all hint texts for a particular puzzle but is still unable to solve it, they may opt to unlock a video that walks them through the exact steps to solve it.

————————

The development phase for Moncage is almost complete and the game is scheduled to launch by the end of 2021. Wishlist us on Steam now to receive the latest updates about the game. 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195290/_Moncage/

notes.title: Everything to know about Moncage
notes.content:
First of all, thank you for following Moncage and for taking the time to read this. We couldn’t be more grateful for the remarkable support from our community thus far and have prepared the answers to some of the most commonly asked questions. We hope this will help give you a more clear understanding of Moncage :)

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/3e10485789772f4ddeaed95dd0a84828efe89aa5.jpg

Q: What is Moncage?
A: Moncage is an adventure puzzle game where the player explores a mysterious cube to uncover the hidden truth. By rotating the cube and seeing it from different perspectives, you connect the clues and objects across seemingly disconnected worlds to solve the puzzles. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/c294aa9121f1b173c373d321b02417eb8c887669.gif

Q: When will Moncage be available?
A: Development for the game is practically complete at this point. We’re now adding some final touches to ensure a flawless launch of a 1.0. Official release is planned for 2021, so stay tuned! 

Q: Where can I purchase/download Moncage?
A: At launch, Moncage will be available on Steam and mobile, followed by a release for Nintendo Switch. Wishlist us on Steam and follow us on Twitter @XD_EN_Official to get the latest updates!

Q: The puzzles seem kinda difficult...
A: Don’t you worry! We integrated thoughtful hints and prompts into the game -  if you ever find yourself stuck on a particular puzzle, try unlocking a hint that may help provide a whole new perspective and point you in the right direction to a solution. We’ll have a walkthrough for how this system works soon!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/1b26617a4ea2beff7abc944801ce91863a00be35.gif

Q: Is there a story to the game?
A: Not only is there a story in Moncage, it is a critical part of the overall experience. Keep in mind that the progression of the story may be disguised as or triggered by specific settings, puzzles, and collectibles. Only by putting all the different pieces together can you uncover the full story.

Q: What was the motivation behind Moncage?
A: We wanted to explore video games as a channel for artistic expression. Moncage was designed to be an experimental puzzle adventure where optical illusions and text-less storytelling seamlessly come together as one. Players are able to immerse themselves in a mysterious, multidimensional setting as they search for clues to gradually uncover the underlying story. 

Here are some early mockups and concept art:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/8d223b7dd5b18a91e6d0986e25d3c3cb9f1ae273.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/dbdf9ad0ff671961dafe6b3b8947451e4b9c6f4c.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/4fa1d9d178d60423e2ae3b7d0f07bdfdcf5e2234.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36302719/b1e66d47e9b1d12a166f40a5db777db32786d66a.jpg

Q: How long have you been working on this game? What is your team like?
A: We are a small team of two and have been working on this game for three years. We have been passionate gamers ourselves, and we both went to NYU for game design, after which we decided to pursue a full-time career in game design and development. With our focus for the game aligned around creativity, both of us were heavily involved in the creative process of the Moncage. We’ve learned a lot from this experience and are super excited for the future ahead of us as game developers.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1195290/_Moncage/
